lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three to four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the branchial region, forming a staggered 2D grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Narrow vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating high-contrast anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, transitioning from high luminance on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral recession.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural truncation on the posterior margin of the right pectoral fin, featuring a large high-luminance white lesion and a trailing elongated filamentous structure.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, elongated low-intensity silhouettes (commensal fish) positioned ventrally to the main flank and trailing the pectoral region.
